engine_smoke.detail: boot-full v2: full APFS container build (System/Data/Preboot) → REAL-KERNEL STAGE (the actual T8030 iOS 13.7 kernelcache from Apple's CDN: 39 MB LZFSE decode, 6/20 T8030 patches applied to real bytes, real ADT drives device attach 59/105 peripherals, and the pure-Rust A13 interpreter executes the kernel's first real function to a clean RET→HLT from __TEXT_EXEC 0xfffffff007bb0000) → launchd→SpringBoard ladder → 2436x1125 homescreen; PLUS 20 CPU groups with the 189-entry golden table; PLUS real TSS response parse (gs.apple.com capture). Next honest gate: kernel image rebase/fixup load (GOT pointers ship zeroed) to boot past the first indirect call. RE-toolkit session: measured 90.52%→98.59% decode / 90.4%→98.6% exec on the real 18C66 kernel text after porting PAC-branches, 9-bit addressing, STP/LDP pairs+SIMD, exception class, register-offset LS, add-sub-extended, LSLV family; 3 decoder bugs fixed (MOV-alias swallow, LDP/STP opc map, SIMD LS width rule). boot-first lane (2026-10-29): BuildManifest identity select + SHA-384 component verification (DeviceTree == all 4 n104ap identities; KernelCache == release identities [1]/[4]) → staged install (staging-manifest.txt, status 0) → iBoot-equivalent machine assembly from the STAGED bytes → real 18C66 kernel first function: 9 insns retired from 0xfffffff007a18000, clean RET→HLT. M1-ISA session (2026-10-29): bug #8 (dp-3 guard rejected UMULH AND misdecoded SMULH as MADD — wrong results on real bytes) + bug #9 (QEMU-anchored Sqrdmlah goldens were unassigned encodings) fixed; dp-1 family (RBIT/REV16/REV32/REV/CLZ/CLS both widths), dp-3 op31 map, logical-ROR landed with capstone-derived gap goldens; measured 98.59%→98.69% decode (7861938/7966342) / 98.6%→98.7% exec on real 18C66; new oracle tool bucket_discover.py; BOOT-PLAN.md (docs/) now drives the 2h-cadence campaign to homescreen. M1-ISA session D+E (2026-10-29): five remaining families landed with capstone-oracle field maps — SIMD ld/st reg-off+multiple+single structures, indexed by-element FP/INT/FP16FML, scalar FP (fcmp/fcsel/fmov-imm/FCVT family), 2-reg-misc (rev/xtn/fcvtln/fcvtzs-vec/accross-lane-add), permute/dup/ins/ext/tbl, SHA1/SHA256 crypto, PMULL.1q, SIMD literals. REAL-DATA bugs #15 (reduce guard swallowed three-same Vm=16/17), #16 (FCVTL decoded as AESIMC), #17 (ADC family decoded as CSEL — bit23 divider). Measured decode 99.03%→99.31% (7911692/7966342) / exec 99.3% — M1 gate ≥99.3% CLEARED; cargo test --workspace 288 passed / 0 failed; boot-first 9 insns / Halted (M2 zeroed-GOT stop, not ISA).
